control_point: Uncleared OTC derivative confirmations are issued and matched with counterparties within the regulatory deadline.

citations.source_name: 17 CFR 23.501 - Confirmation, processing, netting, documentation, and settlement of swaps
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 149/2013 (EMIR RTS on clearing and risk mitigation), Article 12 - timely confirmation

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC swap-confirmation requirements under 17 CFR 23.501 and EU risk-mitigation requirements under Delegated Regulation (EU) 149/2013; associated supervisory remediation orders and penalties
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: published penalties for systematic confirmation backlogs in the low- to mid-million-dollar/euro range, plus heightened supervisory scrutiny and remediation requirements

commonality_rationale: Every market participant entering uncleared OTC derivatives must confirm trades within the timeframe set by its regulator; the control point is operationally common across interest-rate, credit, equity and commodity OTC derivatives in both EU and US regimes.
